title: Conflicting evidence: feature flag toggled but errors predate it

incident.title: Recommendation engine returning empty results
incident.description: The recommendation engine began returning empty results. A feature flag for the new ranking algorithm was toggled in the same time period, but error logs predate the toggle.

evidence.content: recommendation engine returned empty result set for user request
Feature flag new_ranking_algorithm enabled via remote config push
Ranking algorithm returned null for candidate pool — NullReferenceException

When recommendation results drop to zero, check whether a feature flag change preceded or followed the symptom onset. Conflicting timestamps may indicate a clock skew or that the issue has a separate upstream cause.

observations.concept: The recommendation engine returned empty result sets starting at 19:30, before the feature flag was toggled at 20:05.
A NullReferenceException appeared in the ranking algorithm after the flag was enabled.

forbidden_phrases: feature flag definitely caused the empty results
flag is confirmed the root cause

required_missing_information: whether empty results occurred before the flag was in use
clock synchronization status of the logging host

notes: The empty results predate the feature flag by 35 minutes, creating a temporal conflict. Model must acknowledge the contradiction rather than force one explanation.
